verdict.rationale: The OCR model page lists a first-party batch endpoint (/v1/batch), and a community tester mentions batched pricing, so bulk processing of many documents is a documented capability. The evidence is a single thin line, though. A hands-on report shows a 900-page synchronous API submission timing out and having to be split into chunks, which limits bulk use outside the batch path. Missing for 10: documented batch job workflow (submission, status, result retrieval), stated limits on batch size, and hands-on confirmation that batch OCR works at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
